prompts.name: Brief Summary
prompts.use_case: Fast overview for operators and reviewers
prompts.template: Summarize the following content in 5 bullets. Keep each bullet under 18 words. Include at least one risk or caveat. Content: {{content}}

prompts.name: Executive Summary
prompts.template: Produce an executive summary using this structure: Context, Findings, Risks, Actions, Open Questions. Keep it under {{max_words}} words. Audience: {{audience}}. Content: {{content}}

prompts.name: RAG Chunk Summary
prompts.template: Return strict JSON with keys: source_id, summary, entities, numbers, decisions, constraints, unanswered_questions. source_id={{source_id}} chunk={{chunk}}

prompts.name: Model Documentation Checker
prompts.use_case: Review model cards and technical docs for completeness
prompts.template: Audit model documentation against governance checklist. Return JSON with keys: score_0_to_100, missing_sections, risk_findings, evidence_gaps, remediation_plan. Required checklist: intended_use, limitations, training_data, evaluation_metrics, bias_safety, privacy, deployment_monitoring. Document={{model_document_text}}
